scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.prerelease: npm run test && npm run build
scripts.release:benchmarks: git checkout gh-pages && rm -rf ./docs/benchmarks && mv packages/benchmarks/dist ./docs/benchmarks && git add -A && git commit -m "Deploy benchmarks" && git push origin gh-pages && git checkout -
scripts.release:react-native-web-docs: git checkout gh-pages && rm -rf ./docs && mv packages/react-native-web-docs/dist ./docs && git add ./docs && git commit -m "Deploy documentation" && git push origin gh-pages && git checkout -
scripts.postrelease: npm run release:react-native-web-docs && npm run release:benchmarks
scripts.test: npm run flow && npm run format && npm run lint && npm run unit --runInBand
